name: Click Trainer
description: Learn a level's clicks: see exactly where and when to click, right on the level, from your own run or a bot macro.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the click guide when the level has a chart. Toggle in-game with the hotkey below or the Clicks pause menu.

toggle-key.name: On/Off Hotkey
toggle-key.description: Turns the click guide on or off.

style-key.name: Switch View Hotkey
style-key.description: Cycles the views: Gates, Target Rings, Click Track.

view.name: View
view.description: <cg>Gates</c>: a thin line in the level where you click and a thin needle through your icon; click when the needle crosses the gate. <cy>Target Rings</c>: a ring closing onto a circle. <co>Click Track</c>: a strip at the screen edge. <cr>Side Lane</c>: osu!mania lane. Switch in-game with the hotkey below.

practice-only.name: Practice Mode Only
practice-only.description: Only show the guide in practice mode.

gate-anchor.name: Gate Lines Up With
gate-anchor.description: <cg>Icon Center</c>: click when the needle through your icon crosses the gate. <cy>Icon Front</c>: click when your icon's front edge touches the gate.

ring-anchor.name: Ring Closes On
ring-anchor.description: <cg>Click Spot</c>: the ring closes onto the ghost target in the level. <cy>Your Icon</c>: the ring closes around your icon, so you never have to look away from it.

clicks-ahead.name: Clicks Shown Ahead
clicks-ahead.description: Only the next few clicks are shown, to keep the level clear. Only the very next one gets a ring.

target-size.name: Circle / Gate Size (%)
target-size.description: Size of the target circle compared to your icon.

release-size.name: Release Circle / Gate Size (%)
release-size.description: Size of the orange 'let go' circles compared to the click circles.

guide-line.name: Guide Line
guide-line.description: Right before a click, a thin line rises from the mark to the exact spot in the level where your icon will be.

approach-time.name: Ring Closing Time (ms)
approach-time.description: How long the ring takes to close onto the circle. Higher = more warning, slower and easier to read.

look-ahead.name: Look Ahead (ms)
look-ahead.description: How far ahead the route and click markers are shown.

trail-opacity.name: Trail Opacity (%)
trail-opacity.description: The line showing the route ahead. 0 hides it.

outline.name: Dark Outline
outline.description: Draws a dark edge around the trail, dots and rings so they stay visible on bright and dark backgrounds alike.

ring-color.name: Approach Ring Color
ring-color.description: Color of the closing ring. It stays this color the whole way in.

ring-hit-color.name: Flash Color (click now)
ring-hit-color.description: Flashes in this color at the exact moment to click or let go. Nothing changes color before that.

note-speed.name: Note Speed
note-speed.description: How fast notes fall, in pixels per second. Low = slow and easy to read (you see clicks ~2 s ahead at 120). High = osu!mania-style fast.

hit-line-y.name: Hit Line Height
hit-line-y.description: Distance of the hit line from the bottom of the screen.

offset-ticks.name: Chart Offset (ticks)
offset-ticks.description: Shift the whole chart. 1 tick = 1/240 s (~4.2 ms). Use this if imported macros feel consistently early or late.

visual-offset.name: Visual Offset (ms)
visual-offset.description: Makes the rings/marks arrive earlier (+) or later (-) without changing the judgement. Use <cy>Calibrate</c> in the Clicks menu to set it from your average timing.

hold-threshold.name: Hold Note Threshold (ticks)
hold-threshold.description: Presses held longer than this are shown as hold notes with a release marker.

show-judgements.name: Show Judgements
show-judgements.description: Show PERFECT / GREAT / MISS etc. and your timing error.

click-sound.name: Click Sound
click-sound.description: Plays a keyboard click at each of the chart's clicks, right when the cue hits, so you can click along with it. Follows <cy>Visual Offset</c>.

click-volume.name: Click Sound Volume (%)
click-volume.description: Above 100% the click is amplified, and very high values can start to crackle.

click-offset.name: Click Sound Offset (ms)
click-offset.description: The game's audio delay is already compensated. If the click still sounds late (Bluetooth headphones, some sound cards), raise this; lower it if it sounds early.
